task: Raft-lite leader election and log replication (ae.raft) over a seeded simulated unreliable network with safety checker
reasoning_summary: Implemented Raft following the paper (terms, one vote per term, up-to-date check, consistency check, conflict-only truncation, current-term commit rule with leader no-op) and a deterministic SimCluster with loss/dup/delay/partition/crash and a safety checker. Unit tests pin each rule; cluster and 60-seed chaos tests check safety and convergence. First run failed only on a wrong test expectation (no-op occupies index 1); three mutations were killed.
